item.title: Is Tom Barrack fit to represent America in the Middle East?
item.description: When an American envoy says antisemitism “didn’t exist," suggests Zionism became a problem in 1948 and repeatedly gives Israel's adversaries the benefit of the doubt, the question is no longer one unfortunate choice of words. It is one of judgment. Opinion.

item.title: Two towns and six farms planned in response to shooting attack
item.description: The Har Hebron Regional Council has announced plans to establish two new communities and six agricultural farms in the southern Hebron Hills following Friday's deadly terrorist attack near Hebron.

item.title: Shas in turmoil: Senior Sephardic rabbi calls for election boycott
item.description: Rabbi Moshe Tzadka, a leading Sephardic haredi rabbi, instructs followers not to vote for Shas over the military draft dispute. Aryeh Deri scrambles to enlist senior rabbis to reverse the decision.

item.title: Fall back! Israel turns clocks back tonight
item.description: Israel switches to winter time overnight as clocks move back one hour at 2:00 a.m., giving Israelis an extra hour of sleep but bringing earlier sunsets.

item.title: Iran reportedly ready to target submarine cables if war resumes
item.description: Iran has developed detailed plans to attack undersea communications cables in the Gulf if the United States and Israel launch renewed military strikes.

item.title: US intelligence warns of advanced Iranian assassination plots
item.description: US intelligence warns that Iran has intensified assassination plots against American officials abroad, with some reaching advanced stages, Axios report says.

item.title: Following terror attack: IDF arrests 40 terror suspects in sweeping raids
item.description: Israeli security forces raid 400 locations across Judea and Samaria, arresting approximately 40 suspects, including Hamas and Islamic Jihad terrorists, and destroying memorials honoring terrorists.

item.title: The Nobel Peace Prize turned inside out
item.description: The committee cited Pillay for ensuring that genocide is prosecuted, yet the most prominent genocide charge of her career was a despicable libel. Opinion.

item.title: Yair Golan threatens Channel 14, Eli Academy
item.description: Yair Golan's election demands include shutting down Channel 14 if it refuses to sign an ethics code, cutting funding to a pre-military academy, and taking control of four key ministries.

item.title: Winter rejects serving under Eisenkot, then hugs him on live TV
item.description: Ofer Winter declares that an "enormous ideological gulf" separates him from Gadi Eisenkot and rules out serving under him. Moments later, the two meet in the studio and embrace.

item.description:
Otzma Yehudit chairman Itamar Ben Gvir warns that Netanyahu wants a broad government with Gadi Eisenkot and urges right-wing voters not to abandon his party.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: In response to terrorist attack, security forces launch counterterrorism operation in Hebron area
item.description:
In response to the shooting attack in the Judea Junction, in which two IDF soldiers fell and several others were wounded, IDF soldiers, the ISA, Israel Border Police officers, and personnel from the Judea District Coordination and Liaison Administration launched a counterterrorism operation in the Hebron area, from which the terrorists had emerged.
The forces have begun conducting precise, targeted and thorough searches throughout the area to locate and dismantle terrorist infrastructure and weapons, while questioning suspects.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: IDF to simulate surprise attack and infiltration into Israel in large-scale drill
item.description:
The IDF will hold a large-scale military exercise in northern and central Israel this coming Sunday and Monday, involving the Israeli Air Force and forces from the Northern and Central Commands.
The exercise will simulate scenarios including a surprise attack, infiltration into Israeli territory by air and land, and escalation across multiple fronts simultaneously.
Increased movement of security forces and aircraft is expected over the two days. The IDF stressed that the exercise is planned in advance and that there is no concern about an actual security incident.

item.title: White House: Russia-Ukraine ceasefire reached through Melania Trump’s mediation
item.description:
The White House announced that a ceasefire had been reached between Russia and Ukraine in the area of the city of Oleshky in the Kherson region, through the mediation of Melania Trump.
The Ukrainian city, which was captured by Russia, is under a heavy siege and facing a severe humanitarian crisis. According to reports, the approximately 2,000 residents remaining in the city have been forced to survive by eating grass due to food shortages.

item.title: Parashat Lech Lecha: Parenting advice from Abraham
item.description: Our patriarchal father taught us that parenting is a blend of respect and love. You can’t smother a grown child with love and micromanage their affairs. You must respect them enough to give them their space. . They have a funny way of showing their love during certain stages of their lives, but they always need it from us.
